name: Fiery Blaze Enchantments
summary: Sigrun Ironhew, waiting in the Badlands for word from Ironforge, knows a technique for imbuing weapons with fire. It needs blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp, and the whelps of Lethlor Ravine are where to find one.

sections.title: An Apprentice's Craft
sections.body: Sigrun Ironhew learned a special way of imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments as an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, last heard of among a hunting party's smiths in Lordaeron. Sigrun is waiting for word from Ironforge and has little else to do.

sections.title: The Whelps of Lethlor Ravine
sections.body: Sigrun will share few details of the process, only that it calls for blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp. Take a heart from the whelps of that ravine to Sigrun and the skill will be shown to you. The Scalding Whelps and Scorched Guardians there are where the hearts come from.

faq.q: Who taught Sigrun Ironhew this enchantment technique?
faq.answer: Sigrun learned it as an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, last heard of in Lordaeron, with a hunting party's smithy.

faq.q: What component is needed to place fire upon a blade?
faq.answer: Blood drawn from the heart of a rare black drake whelp, one that still beats.

faq.q: Where are the black drake whelps found?
faq.answer: In Lethlor Ravine, in the eastern Badlands.

faq.q: Why is Sigrun Ironhew lingering in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Word from Ironforge is what Sigrun is waiting on, and nothing else is keeping Sigrun busy in the meantime.

faq.q: Which creatures yield the needed heart?
faq.answer: The Scalding Whelps and Scorched Guardians of Lethlor Ravine.

angles.text: Sigrun Ironhew looks to Ironforge for word, and this work is meant for the Alliance.
